name: KENERGY
recent: Kawan Renergy 公布截至 2026 年 7 月 31 日止季度业绩，营收同比增长 32.6%，但净利同比下滑 72.8%。公司此前因电厂项目成本超支而受到关注，并有分析机构下调评级。
notable: 公布截至 2026 年 7 月 31 日止季度业绩，营收 4648.8 万令吉，净利 203.8 万令吉。
有分析机构在业绩低于预期后下调 Kawan Renergy 评级。
risks: 电厂项目出现成本超支。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 7 月 31 日止季度，营收为 4648.8 万令吉，环比增长 1.4%，同比增长 32.6%；净利为 203.8 万令吉，环比增长 177.3%，同比下滑 72.8%；净利率为 4.4%，上一季度为 1.6%。

recent_en: Kawan Renergy reported quarterly results for the period ended 31 July 2026, with revenue up 32.6% year-on-year but net profit down 72.8% year-on-year. The company had earlier drawn attention over cost overruns at a power plant project, and an analyst downgraded the stock.
notable_en: Announced quarterly results for the period ended 31 July 2026, with revenue of MYR 46.488 million and net profit of MYR 2.038 million.
An analyst downgraded Kawan Renergy after results missed expectations.
risks_en: Cost overruns occurred at a power plant project.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 31 July 2026, revenue was MYR 46.488 million, up 1.4% quarter-on-quarter and up 32.6% year-on-year; net profit was MYR 2.038 million, up 177.3% quarter-on-quarter but down 72.8% year-on-year; net margin was 4.4% versus 1.6% in the previous quarter.
